_:
repo ~/i/edahogan/animators-hive-hub. sveltekit 2 (runes only) + tailwind v4 on cloudflare workers via @sveltejs/adapter-cloudflare; aliases $lib = src/lib, $components = src/components. git: push to remote `mine` (public fork 144126/animators-hive-hub, branch main); `origin` is edahogan's and rejects pushes (403), never push it.

goal: fix the 10 critical flaws in ~/search/animators-hive-hub-flaws.md. settled with ed on 2026-10-06: records move from vectorize to d1 database `ahh` (binding DB); videos and thumbnails go to r2 bucket `ahh` (binding M); vectorize and gemini embeddings are removed; deploy = workers builds from mine/main to https://animators-hive-hub.apexlinks.workers.dev. creating the d1 and r2, applying migrations to the remote d1, and deleting vectorize index `ahh` are pre-approved. the old supabase project is gone (nxdomain): nothing to migrate.

contracts: keep the api json shapes in src/lib/types.ts and the request bodies in src/lib/data.ts unless a step says otherwise. all sql lives in src/lib/server/db.ts, lowercase; its functions take the D1Database from `sql(platform)` as their first argument; routes stay thin. table and column letters are defined by the comments in migrations/0001_init.sql. timestamps are integer ms in the db and iso strings (created_at) in json. ids are crypto.randomUUID().

errors: d1 enforces foreign keys. turn `UNIQUE constraint failed: <table>.<col>` and `FOREIGN KEY constraint failed` into 400/404 json errors with `j()` from src/lib/server/session.ts, never a 500.

rules: snake_case; no comments except a non-obvious why; lowercase ui text; never commit .env or .dev.vars. after each mark commit that step's files plus plan/ as a conventional commit `fix|feat|chore(<scope>): <imperative, <=50 chars, lowercase>` with body bullets and the trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`, then `git push mine main`.

deploy: from step worker_and_builds on, every push to mine/main builds and deploys worker `animators-hive-hub` (tag in the notes). after each push confirm the build succeeded with `cf builds list --external-script-id <tag>`; a failed build belongs to the step that pushed it. prod secrets: SESSION_SECRET, and GEMINI_API_KEY until drop_vectorize. the auto-mode classifier sometimes refuses cloud writes (secret put, deletes): block the step with its message, never work around it.

checks: `pnpm check` and `pnpm build` must pass. `pnpm lint` was already red before this plan; ignore it. pnpm output is filtered by rtk; prefix `rtk proxy` for raw output.

wrangler: always `env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN pnpm exec wrangler ...` (the shell token lacks vectorize/d1 rights; wrangler's oauth login has them).

dev server: `pnpm dev` serves :8080 and logs to .log. it reads wrangler.jsonc and .dev.vars only at start, so after changing either, restart it: kill the pid from `ss -ltnp 'sport = :8080'` (never `pkill -f`), then `setsid pnpm dev > .log 2>&1 < /dev/null &`. d1 and r2 are local in dev (.wrangler/state); load the schema with `wrangler d1 migrations apply ahh --local`.

rotate_session_secret.s:
outcome: the session secret published in e32621d works nowhere, and nothing falls back to it.
1. wrangler.jsonc: delete the whole `vars` block. prod gets SESSION_SECRET as a worker secret in step prod_secrets.
2. src/lib/server/session.ts `secret()`: drop the fallback string; when `e.platform?.env?.SESSION_SECRET` is empty, throw sveltekit `error(500, 'missing SESSION_SECRET')`.
3. .dev.vars: replace the SESSION_SECRET value with fresh `openssl rand -base64 32` output; never print it; keep the GEMINI_API_KEY line.
4. if a dev server runs on :8080, restart it so it loads the new value.
fence: leave the rest of session.ts (mac compare, expiry, pbkdf2) alone; those are not critical.
rotate_session_secret.t: ! grep -rqs 9f3c2e1a7b84d056 src wrangler.jsonc .dev.vars && ! grep -q SESSION_SECRET wrangler.jsonc && grep -q 'missing SESSION_SECRET' src/lib/server/session.ts && grep -Eq '^SESSION_SECRET="?[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{40,}' .dev.vars && pnpm check && pnpm build

deploy_pipeline.s: make every push to mine/main deploy, starting with step 1's commit

worker_and_builds.s:
outcome: worker `animators-hive-hub` exists and every push to mine/main builds and deploys it to https://animators-hive-hub.apexlinks.workers.dev.
1. create it (ed's recipe): `curl -sX POST https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/9bdf8703c380fa82142864bf5d99a2d7/workers/workers -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"name":"animators-hive-hub","subdomain":{"enabled":true}}'`. its script tag is the `tag` in `GET .../workers/scripts`. if the token lacks rights, add Workers Scripts Edit to token `opencode-token-manager` (it has API Tokens Edit).
2. `cf builds workers create --script-tag <tag> ...` mirroring `cf builds workers get 9d784fac3ebf48c6a9c94628f57d303f` (worker dump: provider account 60928392 / 144126, build token e5e56f11-815c-4555-8f48-ca4fa39c5414) except repo id 1407752103, repo name animators-hive-hub, branch main, deploy command `pnpm exec wrangler deploy`, previews off. run it with `--dry-run` first.
3. `git push mine main`, then poll `cf builds list --external-script-id <tag>` until the build succeeds; on failure read `cf builds logs` and fix it.
4. `plan critical --note "worker tag <tag>"`.

prod_secrets.s:
outcome: prod signs sessions with its own secret, and sign-up works live.
1. `openssl rand -base64 32 | env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN pnpm exec wrangler secret put SESSION_SECRET --name animators-hive-hub`. never print or store it; it differs from .dev.vars.
2. pipe the GEMINI_API_KEY value from .dev.vars (no quotes, never printed) into `wrangler secret put GEMINI_API_KEY --name animators-hive-hub`; the vectorize code needs it until drop_vectorize.
3. sign up `smk` + 8 random hex at the live url and expect 200. error 1102 or 'exceeded resource limits' means pbkdf2 at 80k iterations is over the free plan's 10 ms cpu: block with the output.
4. if the classifier refuses a secret put, block with its message so ed runs it himself.
prod_secrets.t: s=$(env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN pnpm exec wrangler secret list --name animators-hive-hub) && echo "$s" | grep -q SESSION_SECRET && echo "$s" | grep -q GEMINI_API_KEY && r=smk$(openssl rand -hex 4) && curl -sf -X POST https://animators-hive-hub.apexlinks.workers.dev/api/auth/signup -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{\"email\":\"$r@example.com\",\"password\":\"smoke-pass-1\",\"username\":\"$r\"}" | grep -q '"user":{'

store_switch.t: curl -sf localhost:8080/api/me >/dev/null && node scripts/smoke.ts && pnpm check && pnpm build

schema_sql.s:
outcome: migrations/0001_init.sql holds exactly the sql after the --- line below, byte for byte. write nothing else.
---
-- u user: i id, e email (lowercased), n username (unique, any case), d display name, b bio, a avatar url, l location, w website, p password hash, t created ms
create table u (
	i text primary key,
	e text not null unique,
	n text not null collate nocase unique,
	d text not null default '',
	b text not null default '',
	a text not null default '',
	l text not null default '',
	w text not null default '',
	p text not null,
	t integer not null
);

-- c community: i id, s slug, n name, d description, a avatar url, b banner url, m member count, u creator, t created ms
create table c (
	i text primary key,
	s text not null unique,
	n text not null,
	d text,
	a text,
	b text,
	m integer not null default 1,
	u text not null references u (i) on delete cascade,
	t integer not null
);

-- a animation: i id, u author, c community, ti title, d description, v video url, im thumbnail url, p upvotes, n comments, t created ms
create table a (
	i text primary key,
	u text not null references u (i) on delete cascade,
	c text references c (i) on delete set null,
	ti text not null,
	d text,
	v text,
	im text,
	p integer not null default 0,
	n integer not null default 0,
	t integer not null
);
create index a_t on a (t);
create index a_p on a (p, t);
create index a_u on a (u, t);
create index a_c on a (c, t);

-- v upvote: u user, a animation, t created ms
create table v (
	u text not null references u (i) on delete cascade,
	a text not null references a (i) on delete cascade,
	t integer not null,
	primary key (u, a)
) without rowid;
create index v_a on v (a);

-- n comment: i id, a animation, u author, x text, t created ms
create table n (
	i text primary key,
	a text not null references a (i) on delete cascade,
	u text not null references u (i) on delete cascade,
	x text not null,
	t integer not null
);
create index n_a on n (a, t);

-- l playlist: i id, u owner, n name, d description, t created ms
create table l (
	i text primary key,
	u text not null references u (i) on delete cascade,
	n text not null,
	d text,
	t integer not null
);
create index l_u on l (u, t);

-- li playlist item: i id, l playlist, a animation, t created ms
create table li (
	i text primary key,
	l text not null references l (i) on delete cascade,
	a text not null references a (i) on delete cascade,
	t integer not null,
	unique (l, a)
);
schema_sql.t: test -f migrations/0001_init.sql && node -e "const s = new (require('node:sqlite').DatabaseSync)(':memory:'); s.exec(require('node:fs').readFileSync('migrations/0001_init.sql', 'utf8')); process.exit(s.prepare('select count(*) c from sqlite_master where type = ?').get('table').c === 7 ? 0 : 1)"

bindings.s:
outcome: d1 `ahh` and r2 `ahh` exist and are bound, the local and remote d1 both have the schema, and the app still runs on vectorize.
1. create them (pre-approved): `wrangler d1 create ahh`, `wrangler r2 bucket create ahh`.
2. wrangler.jsonc: add `d1_databases` [{ binding DB, database_name ahh, database_id <from create>, migrations_dir migrations }], `r2_buckets` [{ binding M, bucket_name ahh }] and `"workers_dev": true`; rename the vectorize binding DB to V (drop_vectorize deletes it).
3. `pnpm add -D @cloudflare/workers-types`; src/app.d.ts imports `D1Database` and `R2Bucket` as types and sets Platform.env to `{ DB: D1Database; M: R2Bucket; V: VecIndex; SESSION_SECRET?: string; GEMINI_API_KEY?: string }`. `db()` in src/lib/server/db.ts reads env.V.
4. `wrangler d1 migrations apply ahh --local`, then `--remote` (pre-approved; before the push, which deploys). restart the dev server.
bindings.t: grep -Eq '"binding": ?"V"' wrangler.jsonc && grep -Eq '"binding": ?"M"' wrangler.jsonc && grep -Eq '"database_id": ?"[0-9a-f-]{36}"' wrangler.jsonc && env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN pnpm exec wrangler d1 execute ahh --local --command 'select count(*) from li' >/dev/null && env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN pnpm exec wrangler d1 execute ahh --remote --command 'select count(*) from li' >/dev/null && pnpm check && pnpm build

db_users.s:

1. src/lib/server/db.ts: add `sql(p?: App.Platform): D1Database` (`error(500, 'no d1')` when missing) and `insert_user`, `user_by_id`, `user_by_email`, `save_profile`, returning the existing `UserRow` shape so `public_user` in src/lib/server/session.ts keeps working. leave the vectorize helpers in place.
2. port src/hooks.server.ts and src/routes/api/auth/signup, auth/signin, me and profile (each +server.ts) to them.
3. sign-up: username trimmed, email trimmed and lowercased; unique failure on `u.n` -> 400 'username is already taken', on `u.e` -> 400 'email already used'.

db_anims.s:

1. src/lib/server/db.ts: `list_anims(d, { sort, community_id, author_id })` (sort 'new' = newest, 'top' = most upvoted then newest; limit 20; joined author and community; same json as today's `hydrate` output), `get_anim`, `insert_anim`, `set_vote(d, user_id, anim_id, on)`, `has_vote`, `list_notes(d, anim_id)`, `insert_note`.

media_server.s:
outcome: the server keeps uploads in r2, serves them with range support, and accepts only its own media urls.
1. new src/routes/api/media/+server.ts POST: signed-in only (401). the body is the raw file, its type the content-type: `video/*` up to 50 MiB, `image/*` up to 5 MiB, anything else 415; check content-length first, then the real byte length -> 413. key `crypto.randomUUID()`; `M.put(key, bytes, { httpMetadata: { contentType } })`; reply `{ u: '/media/<key>' }` (u = url, commented).
2. new src/routes/media/[k]/+server.ts GET: k not a uuid -> 404; `M.get(k, { range: request.headers, onlyIf: request.headers })` (if the dev platform proxy rejects Headers, parse `bytes=a-b` yourself); send content-type, etag, `accept-ranges: bytes`, `cache-control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable`; a Range request gets 206 + content-range (o.range may be {suffix} or lack length); no body -> 304. safari only plays video over 206.
3. POST /api/animations: video_url required, thumbnail_url optional, both must match `^/media/[0-9a-f-]{36}$`, else 400 'upload the video first'.
media_server.t: test -f src/routes/api/media/+server.ts && grep -q 'accept-ranges' 'src/routes/media/[k]/+server.ts' && grep -q '206' 'src/routes/media/[k]/+server.ts' && grep -q 'upload the video first' src/routes/api/animations/+server.ts && pnpm check && pnpm build

media_client.s:
outcome: the upload form sends real files and saves their r2 urls; no blob: or data: url can be stored.
1. src/lib/upload.ts: `upload(file: Blob): Promise<string>` posts the file to /api/media with its own content-type (through `api()` in src/lib/http.ts, overriding its json header) and returns `u`. `thumb_from_video` returns a jpeg Blob from `canvas.toBlob`, at most 640 px wide, with the video muted and playsInline, and revokes its object url. delete `file_url`.
2. src/components/AddAnimationModal.svelte: upload the video, then the custom thumbnail or else the generated one (generation failure = no thumbnail), then `create_animation` with the returned urls.
3. look at it: in agent-browser (`ab-1440fl`) sign up, upload a short mp4 with no thumbnail, reload, and check it plays.
media_client.t: grep -q 'function upload' src/lib/upload.ts && grep -q 'toBlob' src/lib/upload.ts && ! grep -qE 'toDataURL|file_url' src/lib/upload.ts src/components/AddAnimationModal.svelte && pnpm check && pnpm build

drop_vectorize.s:
outcome: no vectorize, gemini or dead posts code is left, and prod no longer holds the gemini key.
1. delete src/lib/server/embed.ts; the vectorize helpers and types in src/lib/server/db.ts (db, put, one, many, parse, cat_add, cat_ids, hydrate, VecIndex; keep what the d1 code uses); VecIndex, V and GEMINI_API_KEY in src/app.d.ts; the `parse` import and re-export in src/lib/server/session.ts.
2. wrangler.jsonc: delete the vectorize block.
3. delete the posts feature: src/routes/api/posts/, src/routes/post/, src/components/PostCard.svelte, src/components/PostDetailView.svelte, `list_posts` and `get_post` in src/lib/data.ts, the posts fallback in src/components/DiscoverFeed.svelte, and `Post` in src/lib/types.ts.
4. remove GEMINI_API_KEY from .env.example and .dev.vars; `wrangler secret delete GEMINI_API_KEY --name animators-hive-hub`. README.md in four lines: d1 + r2 `ahh`; run `wrangler d1 migrations apply ahh --local` before `pnpm dev`; .dev.vars needs SESSION_SECRET.
5. restart the dev server.
drop_vectorize.t: test ! -f src/lib/server/embed.ts && test ! -d src/routes/api/posts && test ! -d src/routes/post && test ! -f src/components/PostCard.svelte && ! grep -rqiE 'vectorize|gemini|VecIndex' src wrangler.jsonc README.md .env.example .dev.vars && ! env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN pnpm exec wrangler secret list --name animators-hive-hub | grep -q GEMINI_API_KEY && pnpm check && pnpm build

smoke_test.s:
outcome: scripts/smoke.ts proves the store fixes against a running server, and passes.
1. plain node script (node 24 strips types; global fetch; no deps). BASE env, default http://localhost:8080. on failure print the check's name and exit 1; last line `smoke ok <username> <video key> <image key>`.
2. checks in order: sign up A and B (`smk` + 8 random hex each) -> /api/me returns A at once; A's username upper-cased -> 400; upload 1 KB as video/mp4 and as image/jpeg; GET the video with `Range: bytes=0-9` -> 206 and 10 bytes; create an animation -> GET /api/animations?author_id=A lists it at once; 5 parallel creates -> that list has 6; vote on -> upvote_count 1 and voted true, off -> 0; comment -> listed at once; comment on a random uuid -> 404; playlist + item -> 200, same item -> 400, B adding to A's playlist -> 403; a community -> listed; a cookie for A forged with the old secret `ahh-session-9f3c2e1a7b84d056` -> /api/me user null.
3. apply local migrations, restart the dev server, run it, and fix the app (never the checks) until it passes.
smoke_test.t: curl -sf localhost:8080/api/me >/dev/null && node scripts/smoke.ts && pnpm check && pnpm build

prod_smoke.s:
outcome: the live app passes the smoke test and keeps none of its data.
1. `BASE=https://animators-hive-hub.apexlinks.workers.dev node scripts/smoke.ts`.
2. delete what it made: `wrangler d1 execute ahh --remote --command "delete from u where n like 'smk%'"` (cascades), and the two r2 keys from its last line with `wrangler r2 object delete ahh/<key> --remote`.
3. a sign-up failing with error 1102 or 'exceeded resource limits' means pbkdf2 at 80k iterations is over the free plan's 10 ms cpu: block with the output.
prod_smoke.t: curl -sf https://animators-hive-hub.apexlinks.workers.dev/api/animations | grep -q '"items"' && env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN pnpm exec wrangler d1 execute ahh --remote --json --command "select count(*) as c from u where n like 'smk%'" | grep -q '"c": 0'

drop_index.s: outcome: vectorize index `ahh` is gone; it holds only review and smoke test records, and ed pre-approved deleting it. run `wrangler vectorize delete ahh --force`. if the classifier refuses, block with its message so ed runs it himself.
drop_index.t: env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN pnpm exec wrangler vectorize list --json | node -e "process.exit(JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf8')).some((i) => i.name === 'ahh') ? 1 : 0)"
